channel.title: AI News Digest
channel.description: Official AI product updates from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and GitHub

item.title: Strengthening NATO and allied cyber defenses with AI
item.description: How OpenAI is working with NATO and allied cyber agencies to help trusted defenders find vulnerabilities, test fixes and protect essential systems.

item.title: The King’s Trust and OpenAI launch £1m partnership
item.description: The King’s Trust and OpenAI launch a £1m partnership to help up to 25,000 young people across the UK build practical AI skills for work.

item.title: Strengthening the fight against online child sexual abuse with new tools and support
item.description: New tools, practical guidance, and partnerships will help prevent, detect and respond to online child sexual exploitation and abuse.

item.title: Science at the Frontier: How scientists use ChatGPT
item.description: Explore how more than 1,800 scientists use ChatGPT in research. See findings on daily workflows, reported productivity, and expectations for discovery.

item.title: How Revolut raises ambition without lowering the bar
item.description: Discover how Revolut uses OpenAI models and Codex to cut coding time by 30–60%, scale financial crime investigations, and innovate without compromising security.

item.title: Our first phase of embedded assessments
item.description: OpenAI begins embedded assessments with Apollo Research, METR, and Transluce, and Goodfire to independently evaluate model alignment, safeguards, and monitoring systems.

item.title: More ways to move care forward with ChatGPT for Healthcare
item.description: Introducing computer-use agents, improved clinical answers, and new healthcare plugins that work across healthcare software to get real work done.

item.title: LVMH’s Media Division announces strategic partnership with OpenAI
item.description: LVMH’s Media Division and OpenAI announce a partnership to support journalism with AI and make its publications more accessible through ChatGPT.

item.title: At Holiday Extras, dots get to work before anyone asks
item.description: Dots deliver launch reports unprompted, flag issues people might miss, and talk through upcoming meetings on the commute to work.

item.title: Broadening access to AI for scientists
item.description: We’re expanding our ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program to offer 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to our frontier models.

item.title: OpenAI CSAM Image Classifier
item.description: Approved organizations can use the OpenAI CSAM Image Classifier at no cost to help prioritize images for human review. The model returns separate signals for potential child sexual abuse material (CSAM) and potential AI-generated CSAM.

item.title: Advancing computer-use agents for healthcare teams
item.description: Advancing computer-use agents for healthcare teams

item.title: VS Code retires the Local harness in February 2027
item.description: Visual Studio Code 1.146 deprecates the Local harness, the older software that coordinates the model, context, and tools for GitHub Copilot agent sessions in the editor. The Local harness will be removed in February 2027.

item.title: Take GitHub Mobile with you on iPhone Duo
item.description: GitHub Mobile now supports iPhone Duo, with a layout that adapts when unfolded and vertical tabs to help you move between key areas like Copilot, Pull Requests, Issues, and Notifications. Whether you’re catching up on activity or working with your repositories, you can navigate GitHub on the go.

item.title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — November 9
item.description: This week, bring GitHub Enterprise Server repositories into the Copilot app and see which agent sessions need you first in VS Code. You can also try two new models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Gemini 4 Carbon.

item.title: GitHub Copilot models deprecated on November 16, 2026
item.description: As of today, November 16, 2026, we have deprecated the following models across most GitHub Copilot experiences (including Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions). Note that Claude Opus 4.8 is still available to individual GitHub Copilot subscribers on annual plans.

item.title: Control where GitHub Copilot customizations come from
item.description: As an enterprise administrator, you can now require selected GitHub Copilot customizations to come from plugins or managed settings, rather than standalone user or project configuration. Combined with marketplace restrictions, this lets you distribute approved MCP tools and canvases through a shared plugin library without disabling those capabilities entirely.

item.title: Bulk start AI Scan for repositories
item.description: AI Scan for repositories finds security vulnerabilities on your repository’s default branch. It covers languages CodeQL doesn’t support and finds additional issues in languages CodeQL already analyzes.

item.title: temperature
item.description: Text generated by Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Claude Haiku 4.5 carries Anthropic’s text watermark on supported platforms. How Claude marks AI-generated content lists those platforms. If a request to one of these models sets temperature, top_p, or top_k to a non-default value, the text might not carry the watermark. See Text watermark.

item.title: Shield helps technicians hand off legacy portal work with OpenAI
item.description: Shield uses OpenAI to help IT technicians hand off work in legacy portals. Its Forge agents navigate systems so technicians can focus on issues needing their judgment.

item.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
item.description: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet, a secure way for agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete purchases with user approval and existing card protections.

item.title: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in December
item.description: We will deprecate the following models across all GitHub Copilot experiences (including Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions) on December 14, 2026: Model Deprecation date Suggested alternative Claude Fable 5 2026-12-14 Claude Fable 5.2 Claude Haiku 4.5* 2026-12-14 Claude Haiku 5.5 Gemini 3.8 Flash 2026-12-14 Gemini 4 Hydrogen Gemini 4 Argon 2026-12-14 Gemini 4 Carbon Grok 4.6 2026-12-14 Grok 4.7 Kimi K3 2026-12-14 To be announced *Claude Haiku 4.5 will remain...

item.title: Manage AI Scan for repositories using the REST API
item.description: You can now turn GitHub code scanning’s AI Scan for repositories on or off with the REST API at the organization and repository levels. This public preview adds a repository_scan setting to the existing AI Scan enablement endpoints.

item.title: GitHub Enterprise Server support in the GitHub Copilot app
item.description: You can now bring your work on GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) into the GitHub Copilot app. Add your GHES account to work with remote repositories, issues, and pull requests.

item.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google’s latest Flash model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. It is designed for fast, efficient agentic coding, tool use, and multistep workflows, with improved instruction following over Gemini 3.8 Flash.

item.title: Holiday Extras is rethinking what it can build with Codex
item.description: With Codex, Holiday Extras is turning customer expertise into better apps, higher booking conversion and new possibilities for growth.

item.title: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
item.description: A conversation with Sam Nickless, Partner and Chief Executive Officer at Gilbert + Tobin.

item.title: Supporting research on AI and children’s safety
item.description: OpenAI commits $2 million to research on AI and children’s safety. The work supports shared tools to measure risks and opportunities for young people.

item.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
item.description: Built primarily on OpenAI models, Amplitude’s proactive product agent, Wave, identifies what to build, helps teams ship changes with coding agents, and measures the impact.

item.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
item.description: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen

item.title: self-hosted Claude Managed Agents
item.description: We’ve launched self-hosted Claude Managed Agents. You run the whole Managed Agents service, not only self-hosted sandboxes, on your own infrastructure, and you store agents, sessions, and session history there. The server sends model requests to the provider that you choose, which is Anthropic by default. To request access, contact your Anthropic account team.

item.title: JioStar’s chief architect on AI discovery at 500M-user scale
item.description: JioStar’s Vijay Seshadri explains AI discovery at 500M-user scale. Read his lessons on evals, guardrails, and taking AI into production.

item.title: ChatGPT Plus for veterans and servicemembers
item.description: More than 20,000 veterans and transitioning service members have claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus. See how they use it to prepare for civilian careers.

item.title: End-user safety identifier labels for abuse monitoring
item.description: Feature End-user safety identifier labels for abuse monitoring End-user safety_identifier request labels are available in General Availability (GA) for Gemini ( generateContent and streamGenerateContent ) and Veo ( predictLongRunning ) API calls. API resellers and multi-tenant apps can pass an anonymized per-user ID in labels to attribute policy violations to individual end users. Targeted attribution helps prevent enforcement actions across an entire Google Cloud project.

item.title: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
item.description: Meet the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our state-of-the-art model Gemini Decision for fast, calibrated multimodal decisions.

item.title: GitHub App support for Enterprise Copilot seat management
item.description: Enterprise GitHub Apps can now call the enterprise-level Copilot seat management APIs to control which users and enterprise teams are assigned Copilot seats. The Copilot seat management APIs are accessible with a new enterprise fine-grained permission for Apps: Enterprise Copilot license management.

item.title: Singapore Airlines elevates travel & work with OpenAI technology
item.description: Discover how Singapore Airlines uses OpenAI models and API to enhance customer support, travel discovery, and employee productivity, doubling CSAT for its Kris chatbot.

item.title: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
item.description: Manage your business information, get insights about how your business shows up, and turn interest into action in ChatGPT.

item.title: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
item.description: OpenAI Academy is bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to caregivers in five U.S. cities, helping them build practical AI skills for everyday life.

item.title: Closing the AI guidance gap in education
item.description: New ThinkYoung research and lessons from OpenAI’s EMEA education partnerships on supporting teachers, AI literacy, and independent learning.

item.title: Work at the Frontier: AI’s effect on freelance work
item.description: New research from OpenAI and Upwork finds shifting demand for freelance work, new skill combinations, and larger budgets and more hours for AI-related projects.

item.title: Cross-project governance for semantic governance policies
item.description: Feature Cross-project governance for semantic governance policies You can use semantic governance policies in a multi-project (hub-and-spoke) architecture to centrally govern agents deployed across multiple Google Cloud projects. When you configure a Resource Manager management boundary with the AGENT_MANAGEMENT capability, Agent Registry in the central management project automatically discovers agents across all member projects with their runtime identities intact.

item.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
item.description: AlphaProof Code agents wrote three million lines of proofs in Lean to verify Signal’s core encryption.

item.title: Gemini Intelligence: New features, on more devices
item.description: Gemini Intelligence is rolling out to more devices. See how expanded capabilities across these devices help you do more.

item.title: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare.
item.description: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare to unify clinical data and automate workflows. Reduce administrative burnout. See how it works.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available
item.description: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available

item.title: We’re bringing Adobe’s creative and productivity tools closer to your everyday Google apps.
item.description: Google and Adobe are integrating creative and productivity tools. Edit PDFs in Drive and use Adobe AI in Gemini. See what’s new in this partnership.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Gemini 4 Carbon, Google’s latest model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. It is designed for complex coding, agentic, and reasoning tasks, with a focus on secure code generation and security-focused work.

item.title: C++ language server now auto-configures MSBuild builds
item.description: The Microsoft C++ Language Server for GitHub Copilot CLI now bundles its MSBuild compile commands extractor and invokes it automatically. An agent no longer needs to discover and run a separate configuration skill before it can get precise code intelligence for your project.

item.title: A more informative GitHub dashboard
item.description: Since the new dashboard experience became the default, we’ve heard from developers that it used too much space to show too little. Generous padding, wrapped titles, and a low default item count meant extra navigation just to see what needed attention.
